g.text: Search: Query Scatter-Gather Over Term-Partitioned Shards
Crawl/index (left, async) and query serving (right) run at completely different speeds and never block each other
A query only fans out to shards owning its ACTUAL terms (dashed = async index writes, solid = sync query reads).
A slow shard's per-shard timeout means the merge returns a ranked list from whichever shards answered in time.
